title: Dreamland cabaret band and Wade Whaley's visit
summary: Around 1920 he plays clarinet and sax at the Dreamland cabaret with Udell Wilson's band, and Wade Whaley sees him on the clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: This is in the early 1920s, in other words.

Yeah. Around by 1920. That's right. And we was playing at the dreamland, right next to the Larry Theater. The fellow of the band was from Kansas City. He was a great pianist, but in black keys. His name was Udell Wilson from Kansas City. The tall fellow. He was great. And had Maurice Duran was playing trumpet. And we had Black Benny playing drum. I had Willie San Diego playing banjo. Dreamland. So, it happened. I was playing. And who comes to town but Wade.

Yeah. Come to town, he played at the Larry. for the show. And he always telling him about me. The York Oaks, your host is crying there. And Wade was so surprised to hear that. So, after the show was over, he came over. And they couldn't get him in touch by crying there. They were begging to play because he was playing at the Larry. You know, all the ladies. Oh, come on. You play tonight. Come on with a treat. Play a number. You see? Well, that's what made me on a cyclophone from the clarinet. And Wade, the first one saw me on the clarinet.
